# Hero

Hero is the opt-in shared Rust library for Midwess architectural boundaries.
Its default Cargo feature set is empty. Select only the features required by
the consuming project and target.

## Start Here

- [Overview](README.md): scope, architectural role, common combinations, and feature introductions.
- [Feature Catalog](hero.features.json): machine-readable feature names, targets, implications, APIs, environment variables, and documentation paths.
- [Feature Pages](docs/features/README.md): one focused page per Cargo feature.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): design boundaries and common flows.
- [Cargo Manifest](Cargo.toml): executable source of truth for features and dependencies.
- [Published API Reference](https://docs.rs/midwess-hero/latest/hero/): behavior, examples, feature requirements, and public API details.
- Native rustdoc: generated bundles expose `rustdoc/native/hero/index.html`.
- WASM rustdoc: generated bundles expose `rustdoc/wasm/hero/index.html`.

## Supporting Documents

- [Indexing Guidance](docs/indexing.md): chunking, versioning, access, and retrieval rules.
- [MCP Resource Contract](docs/mcp-resource-contract.md): suggested internal resource layout.
- [Publishing](docs/publishing.md): versioned private documentation bundles.
- [Full Corpus](llms-full.txt): consolidated Markdown documentation.

## Selection Rules

- Read `hero.features.json` before recommending Cargo features.
- Prefer the minimum feature set matching imported Hero modules.
- Include target restrictions and implied features in recommendations.
- Do not recommend `all-features` for production consumers.
- Treat `Cargo.toml` as authoritative when documentation disagrees.
